'dataRoot' is the directory that HOLDS the corpus folder, so the clips are looked for at <dataRoot>/3People-2022-SMPLX/<date>/Session_<S>_pc<N>_<Name>.npz. A relative path resolves against the project root, and the default './' finds a copy of the corpus folder dropped beside Assets/ — with the corpus there, no config file is needed at all.
